name: Doable Self-Hosted AI App Builder
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted multi-tenant AI application builder with workspaces, role-based access, sandboxed previews, code export and Docker deployment; no software license quota or expiry published.
watch_out: Requires your own Docker-capable host or VPS, database and operational maintenance. AI model APIs may charge for tokens; Cloudflare domains, DNS and third-party hosting can also incur fees. Free software does not include hosted compute or free AI inference.
